newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize slips on rain.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize slips on rain.

text.p: Argentine April maize slipped in slow cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange as rains salved the crop after a spate of hot, dry weather, traders said.

April maize shed $1 to $92, farmer prices. March sunflower seed also sagged in the rain, losing $2 to $205. The moisture should improve sunflowers. Spot wheat prices firmed in tight trade as the weather interrupted the harvest. Some exporters also needed to buy high quality wheat after some deliveries turned out to be forrage grade. Spot wheat rose $3 in Bahia Blanca to $130. May soybeans followed Chicago up $3 to $238.
